main_text.l: instruis servos tuos ad prælium. Glorifica de alto manum tuam.
Psalmo CXLIV. Oculi nostri in te speDrant, Domina: Mitte nobis cibum & escam delectantem.
Psalmo CXLV. Lauda anima mea Dominam: cum exierit Spiritus meus, Domina, fit tibi commendatus, &c.
Psalmo CXLVI. Laudate Dominam, Ipsa enim medetur contritis corde, &c.
Psalmo CXLVII. Lauda Hierusalem Dominam. Ipsa enim construit muros tuos, & filios tuos benedicit. Gratia sua te impinguat, pacemque donat terminis tuis.
Psalmo CXLVIII. Laudate Dominum nostram de cœlis.
Psalmo CXLIX. Cantate Domino nostræ canticum novum.
Et Psalmo CL. Laudate Dominam in Sanctis ejus: Laudate eam in virtutibus & miraculis ejus. Omnis spiritus laudet Dominam nostram.

page.notes: Printed text is partly blurred; the reading of several line ends (e.g. "speDrant", "Dominam" for Dominum, "Domina" forms) is doubtful and is given as close as the scan allows. The Psalm headings are set in italic Roman numerals.
